top_fields.name: input
top_fields.description: Input parameters for the generation task

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Text prompt. Required. Describes the desired elements and visual features in the generated video. Supports Chinese and English. Maximum length: 5000 characters.

fields.name: negative_prompt
fields.description: Optional negative prompt describing what should not appear in the video. Supports Chinese and English. Maximum length: 500 characters.

fields.name: reference_image
fields.description: Array of reference image URLs. At least one of `reference_image` or `reference_video` must be provided. The total number of images and videos cannot exceed 5.

fields.name: reference_video
fields.description: Array of reference video URLs. At least one of `reference_image` or `reference_video` must be provided. The total number of images and videos cannot exceed 5.

fields.name: first_frame
fields.description: First frame image URL. At most one image can be provided. If supplied, `aspect_ratio` is ignored and the output uses a ratio close to the first frame image.

fields.name: reference_voice
fields.description:
Audio URL used to specify the voice timbre of the subject in the reference material.

Rules:
- If `reference_video` contains audio and `reference_voice` is not provided, the original video audio is used by default
- If both `reference_video` and `reference_voice` are provided, `reference_voice` takes priority

Audio limits:
- Formats: `wav`, `mp3`
- Duration: `1` to `10` seconds
- File size: up to `30MB`

fields.name: resolution
fields.description: Output video resolution tier. Available values: `720p`, `1080p`. Default value: `1080p`.

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.description:
Output video aspect ratio.

Effective logic:
- If `first_frame` is not provided: the video is generated using the specified `aspect_ratio`
- If `first_frame` is provided: `aspect_ratio` is ignored and the output uses a ratio close to the first frame image

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Output video duration in seconds. Valid range is an integer from `2` to `10`. Default value: `5`.

fields.name: prompt_extend
fields.description: Whether to enable prompt rewriting. When enabled, the model expands the input prompt. This usually works better for short prompts but increases processing time.

fields.name: watermark
fields.description: Whether to add a watermark. The watermark is placed in the lower-right corner of the video with the fixed text "AI generated".

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Random seed. Range: `0-2147483647`. If omitted, the system generates one automatically.

fields.name: nsfw_checker
fields.description: Defaults to false. When false, no additional content filtering is applied and results are returned directly by the model.

top_fields.name: model
top_fields.description: The model name used for generation. This field is required. This endpoint must use the `wan/2-7-r2v` model.

top_fields.name: callBackUrl
top_fields.description: Callback URL for task completion notifications. Optional parameter. If provided, the system will send a POST request to this URL when the task completes, whether it succeeds or fails. If omitted, no callback notification will be sent.

top_fields.name: input
top_fields.description: Input parameters for the reference-to-video task.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Optional text prompt describing the expected elements and visual features in the generated video. Supports Chinese and English. Maximum length: 5000 characters.

fields.name: negative_prompt
fields.description: Optional negative prompt describing content that should not appear in the video. Supports Chinese and English. Maximum length: 500 characters.

fields.name: video_url
fields.description:
URL of the source video to edit. Required. Only one video is supported.

- Formats: `mp4`, `mov`
- Duration: `2` to `10` seconds
- Resolution: width and height range `[240,4096]` pixels
- Aspect ratio: `1:8` to `8:1`
- File size: up to `100MB`
- Supports public `http/https` URLs or temporary `oss` URLs

fields.name: reference_image
fields.description:
Optional reference image URL for character, clothing, or style guidance.

- Formats: `JPEG`, `JPG`, `PNG` (no alpha channel), `WEBP`
- Resolution: width and height range `[240,8000]` pixels
- Aspect ratio: `1:8` to `8:1`
- Supports public `http/https` URLs or temporary `oss` URLs

fields.name: resolution
fields.description:
Output video resolution tier. `1080p` costs more than `720p`. Default value: `1080p`.

- `720p`: 720p
- `1080p`: 1080p

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.description:
Output video aspect ratio.

- If omitted: the output uses an aspect ratio close to the input video
- If provided: the output uses the specified aspect ratio
- Available values: `16:9`, `9:16`, `1:1`, `4:3`, `3:4`

fields.name: duration
fields.description:
Output video duration in seconds.

- Default `0` means using the full input video duration without truncation
- If a value is provided, the output is clipped from second `0` to the specified length
- Valid values are `0` or any integer in `[2,10]`

fields.name: audio_setting
fields.description:
Video audio setting.

- `auto`: default, the model decides whether to regenerate audio based on the `prompt`
- `origin`: force keeping the original input video audio

fields.name: prompt_extend
fields.description: Whether to enable prompt rewriting. When enabled, the model expands the input prompt. This usually works better for short prompts but increases processing time.

fields.name: watermark
fields.description: Whether to add a watermark. The watermark is placed in the lower-right corner of the video with the fixed text "AI generated".

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Random seed. Range: `0-2147483647`. If omitted, the system generates one automatically.

fields.name: nsfw_checker
fields.description: Defaults to false. When false, no additional content filtering is applied and results are returned directly by the model.

top_fields.description: The model name used for generation. This field is required. This endpoint must use the `wan/2-7-videoedit` model.

top_fields.name: callBackUrl
top_fields.description: Callback URL for task completion notifications. Optional parameter. If provided, the system will send a POST request to this URL when the task completes, whether it succeeds or fails. If omitted, no callback notification will be sent.
